title: Chess.com accounts (2025) vs estimated regular chess players worldwide (2012)

source.name: YouGov chess-player survey (commissioned by AGON, 2012) and Chess.com 200-million-member announcement (Apr 2025)

notes: The two figures are 13 years apart and not a live comparison: a 2012 YouGov survey estimated 605 million adults worldwide play chess regularly; Chess.com reported 200 million registered accounts in April 2025. Used to illustrate scale, not a precise ratio.
